script.speaker: student
script.text: Twenty minutes. The four fifteen bus never came.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: There was an accident near the bridge. Everything is late.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then I will walk. It only takes fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: I will come with you. The rain stopped.

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş gecikmenin sebebini 'an accident near the bridge' olarak söylüyor. Yağmurdan söz ediliyor ama yağmur dinmiş.
question.key_line: There was an accident near the bridge.
